title: Lovely couples day out.
text:
Fantastic and in formative day out with our guide Oscar. He took us firstly walking around explaining the history and architecture of Barcelona 
  Oscar was very knowledgeable and pleasant. We then went for a short boat trip to the heliport where we had a short induction and then a 6 minute helicopter flight over Barcelona which was really enjoyable.  All in all an excellent day out and many thanks to Oscar.
author: John_G

title: Not to be missed
text:
We had such a wonderful experience! 
Staff were friendly and we didn’t feel scared for our first Helicopter experience.

title: Great tour and would recommend.
